scope: Apply Inspector-authored focus-visible state styles to the published root canvas without adding an independent tab stop
coverage: root Inspector focus-visible preview reaches the Canvas
Save keeps root focus style draft-only
separate Publish writes the root focus state to the published Page Model
keyboard skip-link navigation activates the published root focus style
root retains tabindex=-1 and does not add a separate Tab stop
legacy/template root does not retain the authored state selector or node ID
desktop and mobile root visual styles preserve their existing lifecycle
acceptance_status: 77.44.7.A and WEB-011 remain OPEN; this proves the root focus-state route, not complete Editor acceptance
